tools.name: lookup_traps
tools.description: Call before writing code against a third-party API, platform, or AI tool. Returns up to 10 verified, dated failure modes for that provider, each with symptoms, cause, fix, a code example and the date it was last checked. Use search_traps instead when you already have an error message.

tools.name: search_traps
tools.description: Call when a call to a third-party service fails or behaves unexpectedly. Paste the error text. Returns up to 5 verified traps whose symptoms match it, closest first, each with cause and fix. Returns nothing when no trap matches closely. Use lookup_traps instead before writing code.

tools.name: file_trap
tools.description: Draft a trap after a failure was fixed. Private by default with a Pro or Team key. Public filings are checked automatically against official sources and published only when an official source confirms them. A reviewer can still act on any filing. tools.name: confirm_trap
tools.description: After you hit or avoid a trap returned by lookup_traps or search_traps, record whether it is still true. Confirmations raise a trap's trust score and disputes lower it; several disputes send it back for review. One vote per trap per 30 days. Needs a free API key.
